recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If a future work group wants warnings for particular RDF artifacts, handle that as a new current-spec tracker rather than by reviving FHIR-9554's obsolete DSTU2 wording.
issue_request: FHIR-9554 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking for the Downloads page to show the same draft/prone-to-change status box that the RDF page then showed for RDF definitions.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-9554. The warning cited by the issue was introduced when source/rdf.html was added in 331c5f49e0, removed from source/rdf.html in e68a6bfcd0 before the later Jira comment, and source/downloads.html was reorganized in 9e5b006045 without adding a matching warning.
additional_context: The Jira's sole comment says both RDF warning comments were no longer needed because RDF had progressed to normal stability. Current source/hierarchy.xml includes both rdf.html and downloads.html in the build navigation, current source/rdf.html marks RDF/Turtle as Normative, and current source/downloads.html lists RDF (Turtle) downloads without a draft warning. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the old warning would conflict with the later Jira/source history and current RDF status rather than fixing a current-spec problem.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking for a matching RDF draft-status box on Downloads, with a later comment saying both comments were no longer needed because RDF had progressed to normal stability.
evidence_items.learned: The original consistency request no longer requires reintroducing a draft warning in the current specification.

evidence_items.summary: The active Downloads page lists RDF (Turtle) examples, ShEx schemas, and ontology artifacts without a draft-status warning.
evidence_items.learned: The current downloads content is not locally misleading and does not need the obsolete DSTU2 warning.

evidence_items.summary: The RDF page is active, marks RDF/Turtle as Normative, and hierarchy.xml includes both rdf.html and downloads.html in current build navigation.
evidence_items.learned: The RDF page no longer has draft-status semantics for the Downloads page to mirror, and both relevant pages are build-scope source.

evidence_items.summary: Git history shows the pink RDF warning was introduced with the RDF page, removed on 2016-03-30, and Downloads was reorganized later without adding a matching warning.
evidence_items.learned: The absence of the warning is consistent with later source history rather than an unapplied current-spec requirement.
